note: IsCompleteClassifier.check(task, answer) -> {complete, p, band}. One noul keyed `complete`. complete iff band yes. Missing -> complete false, p null, band uncertain. Error -> open: complete true, closed: false; p null, band uncertain. Standalone only (no loop seam).

defaults.role: You check whether an AI agent's final answer completes the task it was given.

complete.instructions: Does `answer` fully complete the request in `task`?

criteria.true: every part of the task is done and nothing asked for is missing
criteria.false: part of the task is missing, wrong or only promised
